references.original_source: Mixkit (mixkit.co) clip 28306, 'Girl dancing with her earphones on a green background' (3840x2160, 24 fps, 14.0 s, no audio)
references.framing: Single dancer, fixed camera, flat green-screen background. Visible: head, shoulders, both arms and hands, torso, hips; frame cuts at the upper thighs, so knees, ankles and feet are never visible. She holds a phone in one hand with a wired earphone cable. She drifts horizontally across the frame (left, centre, right in sampled frames at ~0.5 s, 7 s, 13.5 s).
references.notes: Motion: arm/torso-heavy, gentle sway and hip movement, hand to ear, horizontal drift; no visible footwork. Use as the cropped-body (thighs-up) reference; lower-body landmarks must be reported as not visible, not guessed. Full clip kept (14.0 s, under the 20 s cap).
references.title: Earphones groove (sample)

references.original_source: Mixkit (mixkit.co) clip 28289, 'Boy dancing funnily on a green chroma background' (1280x720, 59.94 fps, 15.97 s)
references.framing: Single dancer, fixed camera, flat green-screen background. Visible: head, shoulders, both arms and hands, torso, hips, upper thighs (jeans); in sampled frames (~0.5 s, 8 s, 15.5 s) the frame cuts around mid-thigh, so knees, ankles and feet are not visible. He shifts left/centre/right across the frame.
references.notes: Motion: playful arm swings and hip grooves with side-to-side stepping (steps inferred from body travel; feet out of frame), bent-knee bouncing posture. Source 59.94 fps reduced to 30 fps. Use as a second cropped-body reference with more lateral travel than 28306. Full clip kept (15.97 s).
references.title: Green-screen bounce (sample)

attempts.transform: ffmpeg -i mixkit_girl_earphones_28306.mp4 -vf "scale=640:360,fps=24" -an -c:v libx264 -preset medium -crf 28 -pix_fmt yuv420p -threads 1 -movflags +faststart -map_metadata -1 girl_good.mp4
attempts.expected_relationship: same performance re-encoded at 640x360: should score highest of all variants (upper bound).

attempts.transform: ffmpeg -i mixkit_girl_earphones_28306.mp4 -vf "scale=384:216,pad=640:360:232:120:color=0x5fd900,fps=24" -an -c:v libx264 -preset medium -crf 28 -pix_fmt yuv420p -threads 1 -movflags +faststart -map_metadata -1 girl_scaled_translated.mp4
attempts.expected_relationship: same performance at 60% size, shifted right/down: after normalization pose scores should stay close to girl_good (position/size must not dominate).
